description: Per-op TypeOp::push dispatch oracle: one observable emitExpression render for every routed push entry (typeop.hh:359..912) — 31 opBinary tokens, 3 opUnary tokens, 12 opFunc names, the ZEXT/SEXT cast+hide arms, the opBoolNegate three-branch chain (plain boolean_not / negatetoken comparison flip / double-negation cancellation), the FLOAT_INT2FLOAT/FLOAT2FLOAT/TRUNC typecast forms, the SUBPIECE SUB48 opFunc fallback, and opPtradd's binary_plus form
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7 (same as printc_intnot_token_1204); core types uint1/int1/uint4/int4/uint8/int8/float8/xunknown4/xunknown8; sizeOfInt=4 (stack-pointer derivation capped at 4)
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level via Funcdata::setHighLevel

analysis_options.boundary: PrintC::emitExpression (printc.cc:2468-2495) driven directly on hand-built top ops with NO output varnode (assignment arm skipped); implied sub-expression outputs dispatch via recurse (printlanguage.cc:532 defOp->getOpcode()->push); Rugra side drives PrintC::emit_expression_rpn whose dispatch_op_rpn delegates to crate::typeop::push_opcode_rpn (the TypeOp::push virtual-dispatch twin, MIGW1-TYPEOP-0002)

overall_status: UNTESTED: 59/59 stdout records byte-identical between the locked Ghidra oracle binary and the Rugra fixture (schema + 58 cases); registered residual branches remain UNTESTED (zext_sext_misc_readers, subpiece_special_printing, ptradd_subscript_form, markup_emitter_projection), so this is observed-equal-but-incomplete, not a complete-coverage MATCH (B2 residual-container rule)

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases

coverage.opbinary_token_routes: MATCH: all 31 binary-token push routes (INT_EQUAL..FLOAT_SUB incl. shared static instances less_than/less_equal/divide/modulo/binary_plus/binary_minus/multiply/equal/not_equal) render the printc.cc:36-55 token with spacing=1 on both sides
coverage.opunary_token_routes: MATCH: INT_2COMP/FLOAT_NEG unary_minus and INT_NEGATE bitwise_not (printc.hh:296-297/322)
coverage.opfunc_name_routes: MATCH: CARRY4/SCARRY4/SBORROW4 (getOperatorName + in(0) size), NAN/ABS/SQRT/CEIL/FLOOR/ROUND/POPCOUNT/LZCOUNT (ctor names), CONCAT44 (in0+in1 sizes)
coverage.zext_sext_routes: MATCH: cast arms via the size-8 other-operand reader (isExtensionCastImplied false both sides) and the ZEXT hide arm via the PTRADD reader (unconditional true both sides); ZEXT44/SEXT44 opFunc fallback and misc reader opcodes remain UNTESTED
coverage.boolneg_chain: MATCH: the full three-branch decision (printc.cc:814-828) — branch 3 boolean_not `!0x10`, branch 2 negatetoken flip `0x11 != 0x22` through opBinary's negate prelude (printlanguage.cc:539-545), branch 1 double-negation cancellation `0x11 == 0x22`
coverage.float_conversion_routes: MATCH: FLOAT_INT2FLOAT (absorbZext path consulted), FLOAT_FLOAT2FLOAT, FLOAT_TRUNC -> opTypeCast `(uint4)` forms
coverage.subpiece_route: MATCH: nonzero-offset SUB48 opFunc fallback; special-printing field-extraction arms covered by PRINTC-SUBPIECE-FIELDEXTRACT-0001
coverage.ptradd_route: MATCH: plain binary_plus form; the print_load_value subscript form remains UNTESTED
